title: Complete delayed-rule semantics across formats and engines

source.contract: Reconcile native consuming and NonConsuming ODE/SSA execution against exact initiation/completion laws, prehistory, and continuations. Preserve delays and pending state through both BNGIR versions (v0.1 and v0.2), SBML Level 3 Version 2 delay csymbol exports, and downstream consumers.

oracle.identity: Analytic DDE histories, method-of-steps exact solutions, independent delayed jump-process reference, libSBML L3V2 Core §3.4.6 / §4.12.7, and lossless BNGIR roundtrip semantic-equality certificates.
oracle.law: Consuming delayed rules decrement reactants at initiation and create products at completion; NonConsuming rules leave reactants intact until completion; prehistory evaluates negative-time history identically; BNGIR v0.1 and v0.2 serialize delay expressions and non-consuming flags without semantic loss.
